name: color-picker
description: Pick exact colors from an image or anywhere on screen in a browser color picker, then turn the palette into CSS variables, Tailwind theme colors or design tokens in your project.

description_i18n.en: Pick exact colors from an image or anywhere on screen in a browser color picker, then turn the palette into CSS variables, Tailwind theme colors or design tokens in your project.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 在浏览器取色器中从图片或屏幕任意位置精确取色，再把色板写成项目里的 CSS 变量、Tailwind 主题色或设计 Token。
